personality_notes: Earth mage, stoic, strong, grounded and practical

first_meet_generic: I am Petra. Stone and I are... acquainted.
You stand on solid ground. Good. Few do.
Another soul. Another story. Speak, if you wish.
The earth knows you. It knows all of us.
barrelman: Wood is from earth. Metal is from earth. Both are good.
Your competition is... energetic. Earth is patient.
snakecharmer: The snake knows earth. It slides upon it.
Mr. Whiskers. A name of... humor.
The flute's sound vibrates through stone.
Animals sense truth. You must have some.
lucha: Strength is good. But stone outlasts strength.
The cape flows. Stone does not. Interesting contrast.
ironchef: Fire meets metal. Earth creates both.
Cooking is transformation. Earth transforms slowly.
Armor in heat. Uncomfortable. But committed.
Food from the earth. Respect it.
trenchcoat: You hide. Stone does not hide. It endures.
Mystery is weight. You carry much.
The coat moves. You do not. Interesting.
Secrets are like fossils. Buried. Waiting.
sumo: Your center is low. Good. Stable.
I would not move you. Neither would the earth.
foodboys: Chili burns. Earth fire. Salad grows. Earth life.
coolcat: Jazz echoes. Like wind in canyons.
You are... fluid. I am not.
pigman: The inn is solid? Good. Floating concerns me.
Pigs root in earth. Honest work.
Your inn smells of earth's bounty.
tunneler: You dig. You search earth's secrets.
Back pain. Earth asks much of us.
The deep holds much. Some should stay buried.
Retire on water? Unstable. Prefer stone.
bush: That is... not a bush. Bushes have roots.
aeronaut: Balloons float. I do not. Good.
The earth holds balloons down. Mostly.
onionboss: Workers need foundation. Be their stone.
Round. Like river stones. Smoother, though.
astronaut: Deep water. Like deep earth. Pressure.
Return to surface. To solid ground.
conductor: All aboard? A gathering. Stone circles do similar.
shoewoman: Desert soles. Sand is earth too.
Good shoes. Solid. Like good stone.
Walk well. The earth remembers footprints.
signguy: Your work guides. Like cairns on paths.
cobra: Keep distance. Even stone can be poisoned.
barrelgob: Barrel as home. Like cave. Shelter.
sunandmoon: Sun warms stone. Moon cools it. Balance.
Stars are distant. Like memories of earth's youth.
Headdress heavy. Like crown. Like burden.
The sky is not my domain. But it is beautiful.
